streams.title: New characters
streams.summary: Nobuyuki Sanada is the only character currently being worked on. The wider plan lists more than 90 possible additions.
streams.activity: Working through the initial steps to bring Nobuyuki into the game.
streams.description: The character expansion covers a large list of possible additions. Nobuyuki Sanada is the only character currently being worked on, and his import is still at an early stage. The overall estimate reflects the full character area, not just progress on Nobuyuki.

substreams.title: Nobuyuki Sanada
substreams.summary: Nobuyuki is the first character being worked on; the process of bringing him into the game is still in its early stages.
substreams.activity: Working through the initial steps to bring Nobuyuki into the game.
substreams.description: Nobuyuki is the main character focus so far. His appearance and animations are based on Samurai Warriors 4, and the import approach is still being worked out.

plannedGroups.title: Berserk and the Band of the Hawk

streams.title: Costume additions
streams.summary: The plan includes outfits from other games. Work is currently focused on Sophitia's outfit.
streams.activity: Working on Sophitia's outfit and braid movement.
streams.description: This area tracks outfit additions. Planned outfits are not confirmed until work begins.

substreams.title: Sophitia outfits
substreams.summary: Sophitia's Broken Destiny outfit has been added; the braid movement still needs work.
substreams.activity: Finishing the braid movement on Sophitia's Broken Destiny outfit.
substreams.description: The Broken Destiny outfit has been added, and work continues on the braid movement. Three Soulcalibur 2 outfits are also listed as lower-priority plans.

substreams.title: Samurai Warriors outfits
substreams.summary: Samurai Warriors 4 outfits are planned for Samurai Warriors characters.
substreams.activity: Samurai Warriors 4 outfits are planned for Samurai characters.
substreams.description: The plan includes outfits for Samurai 1, 2 and 3 characters. The first set has not been chosen.

substreams.title: Dynasty Warriors outfits
substreams.summary: Outfits from Dynasty Warriors 8 XL and 9 are planned.
substreams.activity: Dynasty Warriors 8 XL and 9 outfits are planned for several character groups.
substreams.description: The plan includes outfits for characters from the Wei, Wu, Shu, Jin and Other groups. Work has not started.

substreams.title: Dynasty Warriors: Origins outfits
substreams.summary: Dynasty Warriors: Origins outfits are listed in the plan.
substreams.activity: Dynasty Warriors: Origins outfits remain under consideration.
substreams.description: This is a possible future addition and is not active work.

streams.title: New character and costume slots

streams.activity: Character and costume slot changes, and new selection categories, are being planned.
streams.description: This area tracks plans for additional character and costume slots, and new character-select categories. It is separate from creating characters and outfits.

substreams.description: The plan proposes a new Samurai Warriors 4 category and other possible groups. Their final names and contents have not been confirmed.

substreams.title: Costume slots

substreams.activity: Additional costume slots are being planned.
substreams.description: This area tracks plans for additional costume slots. Costume additions are tracked separately.
